description.value: Angry Otter Liquor is a retail liquor store operated by Otter Co-op, a locally-owned cooperative with locations across British Columbia. Situated on Marine Drive in West Vancouver, it offers a convenient stop for touring cyclists looking to resupply with beverages. The OSM record notes wheelchair accessibility, suggesting a step-free entrance.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 57m; stands (covered) at 59m; rack at 72m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a liquor store (shop=alcohol) at 2477 Marine Drive, West Vancouver, with a wheelchair=yes tag. The fetched website confirms the business is real and trading under the 'Angry Otter Liquor' brand operated by Otter Co-op, though the contact/location subpage rendered only dynamic placeholder content with no retrievable address, phone, or amenity detail. A notable concern is that the website's community list (Aldergrove, Surrey, Abbotsford, Delta, Langley, Pitt Meadows, Armstrong, Mission, Chilliwack, Penticton, West Kelowna) does not mention West Vancouver, though the /sites/04 subpage is branded as Angry Otter Liquor and the site is clearly live.
concerns: West Vancouver is not listed among the communities served on the Otter Co-op website (listed communities: Aldergrove, Surrey, Abbotsford, Delta, Langley, Pitt Meadows, Armstrong, Mission, Chilliwack, Penticton, West Kelowna) — the West Vancouver location may be unlisted or the website community list may be incomplete.
The website contact/location page (/sites/04/contact-us) rendered only dynamic JavaScript placeholders; no address, phone, or hours data was retrievable to corroborate the OSM address.
